Chief-executive titles by organization type.

Source: R/data.R
ceo.thesaurus.Rd

Used by resolve_roles() (step 09) for the organization types of org_type_levels(). Each row is a title pattern (a regular expression on the cleaned title, title.v7) for one org_type, with an effect:

ceo

the holder runs the organization when they work at least min_hours a week and are paid at least min_pay. They become the CEO (role.ceo "thesaurus") when the filing has no CEO, when its CEO was only inferred from pay, or when its CEO's title matches outranks.

not_ceo

a holder paid under min_pay is never made the CEO (a lodge secretary or a post treasurer on a stipend).

evidence names the labeled filings or cross-tab behind each entry (FINDINGS.md F-031, F-033). Load it with get_ceo_thesaurus().

Format

A data frame: org_type, title_pattern, effect, outranks, evidence (character), min_hours, min_pay (numeric).

Source

data-raw/crosswalks/ceo-thesaurus.csv.
